{% load web %}{% autoescape off %}# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.description }} Covers {{ overview.companies|num }} active U.S.-listed companies with a combined market cap of {{ overview.total_market_cap|cap }}, reference data as of {{ overview.as_of|asof }}.

Every page is server-rendered HTML; no content needs JavaScript. Each company profile opens with a one-sentence answer, dates every figure, and cites SEC EDGAR. Pages carry schema.org JSON-LD (Corporation, WebPage, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, Article). Informational only, not investment advice.

## Key pages

- [Stock directory]({{ base }}{% url 'web:directory' %}): every covered U.S.-listed company, ranked by market cap
- [Sectors]({{ base }}{% url 'web:sectors' %}): companies grouped by SEC SIC industry code
- [Exchanges]({{ base }}{% url 'web:exchanges' %}): companies grouped by primary listing exchange
- [Glossary]({{ base }}{% url 'web:glossary' %}): definitions of market cap, CIK, FIGI, SIC code, ADR, SPAC and more
- [About and methodology]({{ base }}{% url 'web:about' %}): data sources, refresh schedule, classification rules

## Company profile URLs

Profiles live at `{{ base }}/stocks/<ticker>/`, with the ticker in lower case, e.g. `{{ base }}/stocks/{{ overview.largest.0.ticker|lower }}/`. The full list is in the [sitemap]({{ base }}{% url 'web:sitemap-index' %}).
